hooks.// hooks.PreToolUse: protocol.md and bindings.ts are generated; hand edits get overwritten and fail the golden tests

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | grep -Eq '/app/(docs/protocol\.md|ui/src/bindings\.ts)$' && { echo 'Generated file: do not edit by hand. Regenerate it (see app/docs/architecture.md: gen-docs for protocol.md, UPDATE_BINDINGS=1 cargo test -p bd-app for bindings.ts).' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0

hooks.// hooks.PostToolUse: app/AGENTS.md requires cargo fmt before every commit; direnv exec because cargo only exists in the nix dev shell

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | grep -Eq '/app/.*\.rs$' && { cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/app" && direnv exec . cargo fmt --all; }; exit 0
